tools.name: get-catalog-stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate statistics for the aitmpl.com catalog: number of components per type and global download totals.

tools.name: get-component-details
tools.description: Returns the full catalog entry for one component from aitmpl.com, including its description, category, install command and page URL. Requires the component name (as returned by search-components) and its type.

name.description: The component name or catalog path.

tools.name: get-install-command
tools.description: Returns the exact npx command to install a Claude Code component from aitmpl.com (e.g. "npx claude-code-templates@latest --agent developer-team/frontend-developer").

name.description: The component name or catalog path.

tools.name: search-components
tools.description: Searches the aitmpl.com catalog of Claude Code components (agents, commands, MCPs, settings, hooks, skills, loops, mods, templates) by free-text query. Returns up to 20 matches with name, type, category, description and the npx install command.

query.description: Free-text search over component name, description and category.

type.description: Optional: restrict results to one component type.
